policy: Deferred capabilities are preserved and restartable. Restart only when Lite usage exposes a concrete need.

extensions.name: GSC first-party（GSC 第一方）
extensions.restart_when: A real owned/authorized GSC property is available and first-party demand evidence would change a decision.

extensions.name: Native vs AIHOT（原生 vs AIHOT）
extensions.restart_when: Lite shows a repeated discovery-coverage gap that more seed sources may resolve.

extensions.name: China-social providers（中国社交数据源）
extensions.restart_when: Real Chinese-content usage exposes a repeatable opportunity blind spot in current native sources.

extensions.name: More providers（更多数据源）
extensions.restart_when: A measurable discovery blind spot persists across real Lite runs.

extensions.name: Google Ads / paid demand（付费需求数据）
extensions.restart_when: Commercial demand evidence is required to decide whether an opportunity is worth pursuing.

extensions.name: Complex Dashboard（复杂面板）
extensions.restart_when: The Lite CLI/current dashboard becomes a proven usability bottleneck.

extensions.name: New scoring dimensions（新评分维度）
extensions.restart_when: A real ranking error can be traced to a missing scoring dimension.
